exams.name: Insurance Producer Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Both part one and part 2 must be passed within 90 days of each other. Exam covers knowledge of lines of authority applied for, duties and responsibilities of a producer, and Illinois insurance laws and rules.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered under rules prescribed by the Director, may contract with outside testing service)
exams.quote: A resident individual applying for an insurance producer license must pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to Section 500-45. Both part one and part 2 of the examination must be passed within 90 days of each other.

interval_years.quote: persons who have met the requirements of Sections 500-25 and 500-30 shall be issued a 2-year insurance producer license.

required.quote: Before each license renewal, an insurance producer must satisfactorily complete at least 24 hours of course study or participation in a professional insurance association

hours_per_period.quote: an insurance producer must satisfactorily complete at least 24 hours of course study or participation in a professional insurance association

period_years.quote: persons who have met the requirements of Sections 500-25 and 500-30 shall be issued a 2-year insurance producer license.

topical_requirements.quote: Three of the 24 hours of course study must consist of classroom or webinar ethics instruction.

available.quote: Unless denied a license pursuant to Section 500-70, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident producer license if: (1) the person is currently licensed as a resident and in good standing in his or her home state

requirements.value: Nonresident must be currently licensed and in good standing in home state, submit proper application and fees, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Illinois residents on the same basis. Exam and pre-licensing education waived for qualifying nonresidents.
requirements.quote: The Director shall waive any requirements for a nonresident license applicant with a valid license from his or her home state, except the requirements imposed by Section 500-40 of this Article, if the applicant's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this State on the same basis.

bonding_required.quote: An insurance producer who places insurance either directly or indirectly with an insurer with which the insurance producer does not have an agency contract must maintain in force while licensed a bond in favor of the people of the State of Illinois executed by an authorized surety company

definition_quote.value: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this State to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this State to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" means to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurance company. "Solicit" means attempting to sell insurance or asking or urging a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular company. "Negotiate" means the act of conferring directly with or offering advice directly to a purchaser or prospective purchaser of a particular contract of insurance

value: Variable life and variable annuity products
Any other line of insurance permitted under State laws or rules
lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive qualification for a license in one or more of the following lines of authority: (1) Life ... (2) Variable life and variable annuity products ... (3) Accident and health or sickness ... (4) Property ... (5) Casualty ... (6) Personal lines ... (7) Any other line of insurance permitted under State laws or rules.

resident_license_available.quote: A resident individual applying for an insurance producer license must make application on a form specified by the Director

nonresident_license_available.quote: Unless denied a license pursuant to Section 500-70, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident producer license

preexamination_education_hours.quote: A pre-licensing course of study for each class of insurance for which an insurance producer license is requested must be established in accordance with rules prescribed by the Director and must consist of the following minimum hours: Life (Class 1(a)) 20 Accident and Health (Class 1(b) or 2(a)) 20 Fire (Class 3) 20 Casualty (Class 2) 20 Personal Lines-Property Casualty 20

value: previously licensed for same lines of authority in another state (if currently licensed or within 90 days of cancellation in good standing)
exam_waiver_designations.quote: An individual who applies for an insurance producer license in this State who was previously licensed for the same lines of authority in another state shall not be required to complete any pre-licensing education or examination.

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer must obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: the business entity has designated a licensed producer responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and rules of this State.

temporary_license_available.quote: The Director may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed 180 days

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The Director may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed 180 days and, at the discretion of the Director, may renew the temporary producer license for an additional 180 days

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of an insurer that terminates the appointment, employment, contract, or other insurance business relationship with a producer must notify the Director within 30 days following the effective date of the termination

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: Any money that an insurance producer, limited line producer, temporary insurance producer, business entity, or surplus line producer receives for soliciting, negotiating, effecting, procuring, renewing, continuing, or binding policies of insurance shall be held in a fiduciary capacity and shall not be misappropriated, converted, or improperly withheld.

additional_fee_for_commercial_business_a.quote: When an insurance producer or business entity charges any fee or compensation separate from commissions deductible from, or directly attributable to, premiums on insurance policies or contracts, it must comply with all of the following: (1) It must provide written disclosure to the consumer or contracting party that clearly specifies the amount or extent of the compensation or fee prior to the delivery of the corresponding policy.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: An individual who, while licensed as an insurance producer, is convicted of a felony, must report the conviction to the Director within 30 days after the entry date of the judgment.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The Director may verify the producer's licensing status through the Producer Database maintained by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners or its affiliates or subsidiaries

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this State must make application within 90 days after establishing legal residence to become a resident licensee pursuant to Section 500-30.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An individual insurance producer who allows his or her license to lapse may, within 12 months after the due date of the renewal fee, be issued a license without the necessity of passing a written examination.
